listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom — Switch edition (totk-recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Tears of the Kingdom Linux x86-64 port translating AArch64 main and parts of the SDK to C++ with native services and NVN-to-Vulkan support. The separate zeldaret matching-decompilation project does not establish its playability. The author reports one Steam Deck outdoor walk at 62–64 FPS, rather than full-game stability or completion. First start warms shaders; faster code generation is planned. A PC clang O2 build took 17 minutes elapsed and 2.1 CPU hours; a one-to-1.5-hour Deck estimate is unmeasured. There are no release files. Use build_from_xci.sh to import, generate, compile and package privately; the launcher’s game-build button is not connected, so the command line is required. Build requirements include exactly Capstone 5.0.9, 16 GB RAM and 45 GB peak disk. Linux x86-64 needs AVX2 on Haswell/Zen 2 or newer; distrobox Ubuntu 24.04 or Linux PC builds are documented. Windows/macOS are unconfirmed. Supply your own version 1.0.0 cartridge XCI, title 0100F2C0115B6000, main build ID 082CE09B06E33A12 and prod.keys with master-key revision 0x0E. Other versions are unsupported; separate firmware and exact regional hashes are unspecified. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
